## overview

Summit Expedition is an online board game for math tutoring where students race to climb Mt. Axiom by solving math problems. On each turn a player rolls a die, then chooses how hard a problem to take on: Safe, Bold or Daring. Harder problems move them farther up the trail when answered correctly. Wrong answers never send anyone backward. The student sees a worked solution and earns insight tokens that trade for power-up cards, such as a hint or a second try. Along the way there are supply caches, weather events, camps, and a risky Ice Ridge shortcut guarded by an Ice Wall.

Tutors choose which topics are in play, from Algebra 1 through Calculus, and problems are generated fresh each time. The difficulty adjusts quietly to how the student is doing. Tutor tools let you override answers, give retries or change topics mid-game. A session report at the end shows each student’s accuracy by skill and every problem they missed. Up to four players can climb, including the tutor, and it works over screen-share for online sessions anywhere.
